name: getids
description: return an object with all your elements, where each key is the element's id
readme: # getids Returns an object with all DOM nodes by id. It does not return nodes that have no ID. There is one optional argument, either a DOM node, or the ID for a DOM node. If you do not specify one, it will use ```document``` ```npm install getids``` ## Why? Because I end up writing 20 lines of getElementById when I build interfaces. ## example given this html ```html
